basis: Polymarket core CPI: 0.2% is the base case; the hot side is priced well above the soft side
bear: Core 0.3% or more: hike locked in, 2027 hikes start to price, risk-off
bull: Core 0.1% or less: December hike odds fall, relief across risk
lean: Hot print firms up a December hike: risk-off. Soft print takes hike odds down: relief.

basis: Desk view: matters only if it disagrees with CPI

bull: Soft pipeline prices confirm a cooling CPI

priced_basis: Desk view: consensus sets the bar, and CPI the day before moves it

basis: Polymarket prices an EPS beat at about 94%, so the guide decides

bull: Guide above the $108B range and capex reaffirmed: Nasdaq and AI tokens bid
lean: AI-capex barometer. A miss or soft guide hits Nasdaq and AI tokens together.
priced_basis: Desk view: an EPS beat is about 94% priced, the guide is not

basis: Desk view: no direction of its own

basis: Desk view: pins price into expiry, frees it after
